events.detail: Two preliminary runs were invalidated because stale PWD and permissive shell wildcard rules allowed exploration outside the candidate. The accepted run exported candidate-local PWD/OLDPWD and used fixed shell commands.
OpenCode received Kotlin compiler diagnostics only and repaired PollHistoryPresenter and TimelinePresenter. No semantic testcase feedback was disclosed.

The first external build used JDK 17 and was invalidated. A JDK 21 build compiled successfully but ran out of disk during APK packaging. After generated-cache cleanup, assembleGplayDebug completed successfully.
OpenCode received Kotlin compiler diagnostics only and repaired coroutine and ImeAction errors. No semantic testcase feedback was disclosed.
An APK packaging attempt ran out of disk. After generated-cache cleanup, assembleGplayDebug completed successfully in 29 seconds.
